description: This file defines a PatientService class that provides methods to interact with a 'patients' table in a database via Supabase. The class includes methods for upserting a patient, retrieving a patient by user ID, and searching patients by name.

classes.name: PatientService
classes.description: A service class providing database operations related to patients, including upserting, fetching by user ID, and searching by name.

methods.name: upsertPatient
methods.description: Inserts or updates a patient record in the database and returns the updated Patient object.

methods.name: getPatientByUserId
methods.description: Fetches a patient by their associated user ID, returning a Patient object or null if not found.

methods.name: searchPatientsByName
methods.description: Searches for patients whose names match the provided query string, returning a list of Patient objects.
